description: Quartzo external capture ingress transport contract. The bridge writes only envelopes/media under _capture_ingress; Quartzo app canonicalizes into normal Journal Entries.

identity.whatsapp_capture_id: wa_ + first 32 lowercase hex chars of sha256('whatsapp\0' + provider_message_id)

bridge_auth.worker_to_apps_script: POST body contains timestamp, payload, and signature. signature = hex(hmac_sha256(BRIDGE_SHARED_SECRET, timestamp + '.' + payload)). Apps Script verifies the exact payload string before JSON parsing.
bridge_auth.vault_folder: Apps Script requires VAULT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID and must open that exact Drive folder with DriveApp.getFolderById.
bridge_auth.sender_allowlist: Worker and Apps Script both validate ALLOWED_WA_IDS.
bridge_auth.graph_version: META_GRAPH_VERSION is the only configurable Graph API version source. Bridge code must not hardcode scattered Graph API versions.

processing.owner: Quartzo app canonical Journal owner via UnifiedCaptureEngine and JournalNotifier.
rules: A malformed envelope never blocks other envelopes.
Run multiple passes while progress is made.
Missing stable targets never append fallback entries.
Delete is disabled in V1 and must not block other files.
Only successful envelopes are removed from _capture_ingress.
Temporary media is removed only after canonical persistence succeeds.

activity_history.privacy: Activity events must not persist the private message body.

free_only_invariants: No external database is canonical state.
No bridge writes final daily note Markdown.
No outbound WhatsApp response is required.
Retries must be idempotent by capture_id and operation_id.
